findings.explanation: 1 cookie(s) classified as requiring consent were stored before any interaction with the page: _ga (Google Analytics, analytics, first-party). Art. 5(3) requires prior consent for storing information on the visitor's device unless it is strictly necessary for a service the visitor requested.

1 known tracking service(s) were contacted before any interaction with the page: Fixture Tracker (tracker.test, first request at 0.0 s). The EDPB considers that sending information from the device through tracking pixels and URLs falls within Art. 5(3) and requires prior consent unless an exemption applies.
No localStorage or sessionStorage key associated with analytics or advertising was written before any interaction. No Web Storage key was written.

Trackers requiring consent were observed (cookie _ga and Fixture Tracker requests), but no consent interface was detected on the first screen. Consent under Art. 5(3) has to be obtained before such trackers are used.
No consent interface was detected, so there is no first layer to examine. Whether one is needed is covered by EP-04.
The analytics cookie(s) stored before consent have a lifetime of 13 months or less: _ga (13.0 months (395 days)).
This point cannot be established by observing the website from outside. It is listed so a reviewer can examine it.
